issues.observation: MaterialLighting: hero lower resin remains a broad pale solid-looking band; side has dominant bright patches rather than consistently readable clear fill.
issues.requested_change: Use a narrower darker witness card, darker ground and reduced broad illumination. Check that transmitted/refracted content and the free surface remain distinct in all views.

issues.observation: MaterialLighting: the hero upper stream remains low-contrast although side-view reflection continuity has improved.
issues.requested_change: Balance the stream reflection strip against the darker set. In the next images verify nozzle-to-impact visibility rather than inferring it from the lighting values.

issues.observation: Modeling source audit: the thicker .09-radius stream exceeds the old fixed .072 nozzle exit radius; shrinking the card alone would leave its fixed-position markers beyond its edges.
issues.requested_change: Producer source revision must derive nozzle bore clearance from stream radius and keep witness markers within the card. Record source identity so this geometry change is traceable.

issues.observation: Render: native-size grain persists in all raw images. A separately inspected HDR color-only OIDN hero reduced grain but softened fine surface detail.
issues.requested_change: Retain raw images and create separately labeled same-transform denoised outputs for every final view. Inspect thin stream/meniscus detail without presenting denoising as physical validation.

summary: Actual hero, side and top pixels of iteration 002 were inspected at 640x640. Compared with iteration 001, rim/base contours and material reflections are clearer and side-view stream visibility improves. Top still shows a distinct liquid free surface. Hero lower fill nevertheless appears pale and solid-like, while part of the upper stream remains weak-contrast. Raw images still carry grain. Approve one final bounded lighting/background experiment, with no promise of beauty acceptance. The producer is also correcting nozzle-bore clearance and marker placement in source; this is a look-development revision, not a parameter-only controlled benchmark. No photographic reference agreement or browser parity is claimed.
